import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create sample DataFrame
df_pandas = pd.DataFrame({
    "user_id": ["123", "456", "789"],
    "score": [1.23456789, 2.34567890, 3.45678901]
})

# Convert to narwhals and transform dtypes
df = nw.from_native(df_pandas)
df_converted = df.with_columns(
    user_id=nw.col("user_id").cast(nw.Int32),
    score=nw.col("score").cast(nw.Float32)
)

# Convert back to native format
result = nw.to_native(df_converted)
print(result)
print(result.dtypes)
